title: RFC 9449 DPoP Proof Claims
description: JSON Schema for RFC 9449 Demonstrating Proof of Possession (DPoP) JWT payload claims.

jti.description: Unique identifier for the DPoP proof JWT to prevent replay attacks.

htm.description: The HTTP method of the request to which the proof is attached.

htu.description: The HTTP URI to which the request is made without query and fragment.

iat.description: Creation timestamp in seconds since Unix epoch.

exp.description: Expiration timestamp in seconds since Unix epoch.

ath.description: Hash of the access token (Base64url-encoded SHA-256).
